Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework`.

This is a SAFETY-tier review of the full diff against upstream main, including the changes inherited from #3353.
I tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3387`. I used no GitHub runner.
The trial merge with upstream main `62353ac753947eba162538e0d9305ad86858cfb3` was clean.
The reviewed PR head remains `6e2d7d8f092d277d10418c6f62fab0de497109a9`.
The rules came from that upstream main revision, including its UI steering file.

**What looks good**

- The Face change follows the exception in #3356. Its disabled Auto row states why Face has no inside or outside order.
- The MCP refusal occurs before a command changes the job. The new test checks all three words and confirms that the job stays unchanged.
- Auto keeps the old stable ring order: ascending `kmax - k` is the same order as descending `k`.
- No golden, snapshot PNG, dependency, importer, or fixture file changes in this diff.

The heavy run passed 105 tests. It also checked four known-fail tests, which failed as expected.
The detailed tables below name every quick step and every reached heavy lane.
The heavy run includes the reached light twins through `--ignored`.

The UI failure is reproducible on upstream main. The parallel crash has no confirmed cause.
The quick result remains red. The serial result does not establish a green parallel run.

```text
crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tests.rs:69:5
assertion `left == right` failed: clicking Write tool list at [[551.0 514.0] - [569.0 532.0]] must toggle draft value
  left: Some(Bool(false))
 right: Some(Bool(true))

parallel UI lib:
signal: 11, SIGSEGV: invalid memory reference
```

**Extra suites run**

The extra-selection rules add no suites: no fixture directory or importer code changed.
The full serial UI run and both isolated post-dialog runs were additional checks of the quick failure.

**Mutation checks run by this review**

1. Remove only the new Face guard from `mcp/edit.rs`. `mcp_refuses_pass_start_on_face_by_the_row_order` fails at line 36. The error lacks the Face reason. Restore the guard: 1 passed.
2. Remove only the Face row call from `mill2d_page.rs`. `egui_app::tests::pass_start::the_face_passes_tab_says_it_has_no_pass_order` fails at line 55: 0 rows, expected 1. Restore the call: 1 passed.

Each mutation ran separately. I restored each file before the next check.
The worktree was clean after both checks and before the heavy run.

**Hand traces and goldens**

For a hole-free 40 mm square, a 6 mm Face tool and 3 mm spacing give row centers Y=3, 6, ..., 36, 37.
The X endpoints are -3 and 43. Each row reverses direction. There is no ring family to rank.
The Face planner is unchanged.

For an annulus without a split, Outside ranks the outer family from its boundary inward, then the hole family back to its wall.
After a split, the winding no longer identifies the start-side family. Finding 1 describes the resulting slot.
No golden file moved, so there is no changed golden line to accept.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Inherited slotting defect:** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pass_start.rs:51`, used by `crates/motion/src/machining2d/waterscan.rs:136`.
   The rank treats every counter-clockwise loop as an outer-family loop.
   After an offset splits a band, each piece has both stock-side and part-side arcs in one counter-clockwise loop.
   A hand trace uses a 100 x 40 cutter-center rectangle with a radius-15 hole and a 4 mm step.
   The first erosion splits the region. The piece loops include part-side arcs that Outside cuts before the hole-family rings.
   Those arcs still encounter uncut material on both sides. The first and last move checks do not detect this slot.
   This is the unchanged defect [confirmed on the parent PR](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3353#issuecomment-7077878022).
   Update the stack with the corrected parent before merge. Add an engagement check along the whole level.
   Correct the unconditional no-slot claims in the UI hint, guide, decision file, and MCP skill row.
2. **UI validation remains red:** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tests.rs:69`.
   The quick UI library step fails and then crashes. The serial rerun retains the checkbox failure.
   The isolated assertion also fails on upstream main. This evidence identifies a baseline failure, not a new checkbox regression.
   Resolve the baseline failure and the parallel crash, or record the maintainer's disposition, before this validation hold is removed.
   Run the UI library suite again on the final trial merge and record its result.
3. **Missing UI evidence:** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs:74` and the PR body.
   The body states that no GUI screenshot was taken. It has no before/after screenshots.
   Add before/after views of the Face Passes tab. Show the disabled Auto combo and the visible reason.
   Put screenshots only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body.
4. **Missing process declaration:** `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:152` and the PR body.
   The full PR diff changes this process file. The body lacks the required line `Process change: yes`.
   Add that exact line. The merging session owns the version bump; this PR must not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.

**Notes**

The Face-only behavior tests pass, including both independent mutation checks.
The first finding belongs to the inherited #3353 implementation. This head still contains it.
The UI baseline assertion and the unexplained parallel crash are reported separately from that code finding.
No code fix or evidence file was committed to the PR branch.
